description: Tests reconciliation of a historical breast cancer with a supported new lung primary.

documents.text: Remote right breast ductal carcinoma in situ treated surgically; no invasive disease documented.
Spiculated 1.8 cm left upper lobe mass without distant metastatic disease on PET/CT.
Left upper lobe biopsy: pulmonary adenocarcinoma, TTF-1 and Napsin A positive, GATA3 and ER negative, supporting lung primary.
Left upper lobectomy with hilar and mediastinal lymph node sampling performed.
